comparison.objective: Transfer a vial through a wall using a pivoting tong; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Remote lever-actuated grasp, constrained transport, and upright release versus direct tool engagement, rotary adjustment, torque control, and dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Vial upright, stable, and jaws clear with no tip/drop versus two safe locked carriage cycles. Candidate lacks complete numeric rebound/overload/drift thresholds.
comparison.reason: No meaningful overlap beyond controlled grasp and release.
